name: investment.returns

list.description: Acquire complete accrual and cash sources independently and assemble their reviewed parent union.

parameters.name: accrual-from-date
parameters.description: Native accrual transactionDate from bound, YYYYMMDD; the paired start must not exceed end.

parameters.name: accrual-to-date
parameters.description: Native accrual transactionDate to bound, YYYYMMDD; the paired start must not exceed end.

parameters.name: settlement-from-date
parameters.description: Independent native cash settlementDate from bound, YYYYMMDD; the paired start must not exceed end.

parameters.name: settlement-to-date
parameters.description: Independent native cash settlementDate to bound, YYYYMMDD; the paired start must not exceed end.

parameters.name: accrual-investment-no
parameters.description: Optional repeated native investment reference for ACCRUAL acquisition only, sent in transactionId array. Cash remains independently settlement-date scoped; omitted means all accrual parents in its date scope.

summary: Investment returns with native source children.
purpose: Inspect complete independent daily accrual and cash events grouped by the approved investment parent reference.

fields.name: investmentNo
fields.meaning: Parent union reference: accrual.investmentNo or cash.transactionId, with native child fields retained.

fields.name: accrual
fields.meaning: Full native daily accrual records in the independently selected accrual scope; identity investmentNo+transactionDate.

fields.name: cash
fields.meaning: Full native cash events in the independent settlement-date scope; identity native id.

identity_description: One assembled root per native investment parent in the union of the two acquired source scopes.
limitations: Accrual uses POST JSON /accrualBaseList.json with fixed tenant/timeZone, explicit accrual date bounds and optional transactionId reference array. Cash uses POST JSON /cashBaseList.json with its independent settlement date pair and fixed empty posting-date selectors.

Both sources use qualified width5000 and zero-based offsets, validating their own native totals, identities and source scopes. This is not a measured backend maximum; there is no alternate-width fallback.

Accrual source identity is the native investmentNo+transactionDate tuple, hashed internally by the existing SDK policy; cash identity is its native id. Parent references and event identities are distinct.

Pure assembly preserves each complete native child exactly once, source order and all unknown/nested values. Parent order follows first accrual references, then new cash references. No holdings lookup or value/date/amount conversion is performed.
Empty accrual/cash arrays mean no child within that successful complete source scope, not complete parent history or absence outside the independently selected dates/reference filter.

Any incomplete or failed required source fails the aggregate and preserves the earlier saved capture. Only a complete nonempty refresh publishes; live does not publish. No Get or --basis route is declared, and no runtime Duckdog import contract is added.
